title: Pulse early access: launch post

request.brief: Announce early-access pilots for Sonderline Pulse to operations leaders at multi-site organizations. Goal: demo requests. Needs feed, square, link-card and story versions this week.

content.headline: Meet Pulse.
content.label: SONDERLINE PULSE
content.lead: A clearer view across every location.

caption: Meet Pulse. Pulse gives operations leaders a consolidated view of site activity, service requests, escalations and team updates. It is for organizations managing multiple locations. Early-access pilots planned for Q1 2027. Request a Pulse demo.
alt: Black-and-white photograph of a person in a dark coat moving through a glass concourse, blurred with motion. Headline: Meet Pulse. A clearer view across every location. Request a Pulse demo. Early access: pilots planned for Q1 2027. Sonderline logo.
